verdict.summary: Solid: Witcher 3 Remastered's Steam record (a single-source Collider/SteamDB figure, with the Oct 4 vs 5 date still disputed), Deadlock's record (confirmed but a poor fit for the channel and not officially released), the GTA VI Nov 19 date (reaffirmed Aug 7, with delay risk), the Pokopia 5M milestone (confirmed but from Aug, so older than 60 days), the Final Fantasy Resonance Oct 22 date, and the RE Switch 2 Oct 16 date. thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Conceptual contrast (big vs small, cheap vs expensive, before vs after) as the click driver, plus short on-thumbnail text legible on mobile (over half of traffic is mobile)

what_is_fading: Generic open-mouth shocked faces: weak evidence only (secondary newsletter and blog claims, no figures). Source: https://news.rizzle.com/p/youtubers-often-try-new-thumbnails-learn-mrbeast-strategy
Misleading or bait thumbnails: vidIQ guidance (via search summary, unverified directly) advises against them, and Test & Compare's watch-time metric penalizes them in principle.
NOT FOUND: hard data on which title or thumbnail styles are overused or declining for gaming video essays.

youtube_guidance.point: Test & Compare (YouTube Studio) can test Title only, Thumbnail only, or both, up to 3 variants, one video per test, typically 1-2 weeks. Winner is chosen by watch time share, not CTR. Outcomes: Winner / Performed the same / Inconclusive. Needs Advanced Features (identity verification), desktop only, long-form public videos, no Shorts. Guidance of about 1,000-5,000 impressions per variant is the vendor's suggestion, not YouTube's. All of this comes from a third-party vendor article dated 2026-07-14, who sells a competing tool. I could not retrieve YouTube's own help page (the URL I tried returned an unrelated page).

Rollout history: thumbnails announced at VidCon 2023, rolled out 2024; title tests were 'starting to experiment' with a small share of creators in July 2025 (Tubefilter); a vendor claims global expansion in December 2025 (unverified, and sources disagree on whether YPP membership is needed).

Implication for EP003: with a small channel, Test & Compare needs impressions, so plan to test two clearly different packages (curiosity 'Why' question vs clearer keyword title) in the first 1-2 weeks. Watch time share as winner favors packaging that matches the video's actual promise.
NOT FOUND: YouTube statements on Home vs Search differences for titles/thumbnails in 2026, and any concrete recent view-count-vs-channel-size examples of gaming essays.

report.notes: Research quality is LOW. Searches returned mostly SEO and tool-vendor blogs; I found no primary data and no YouTube-official page. I corrected a typo in one youtube_guidance source URL: the correct one is https://vidanalyze.com/news/youtube-ab-testing-for-titles-thumbnails-2026-guide (the first youtube_guidance entry has 'vanidanalyze' by mistake). No concrete example videos with views relative to channel size were found, so none are claimed. Channel-scale context only: Videogamedunkey over 7M subs as of Jan 2026 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Videogamedunkey), Any Austin about 182M total views (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Any_Austin), neither a title or thumbnail finding. About the usage spend the user asked for: I have no tool in this session that reports token or cost spend, so I cannot state how much has been used; the only figure visible is the token budget remaining, about 14.94M tokens of 15M, which is not a cost. Check usage in the Claude settings or billing page. Recommendation: rely on a 2-variant Test & Compare plan for EP003 and treat the pattern claims as hypotheses.

verdict.summary: Solid: the Test & Compare mechanics (confirmed against YouTube's official help page and the July 2026 vendor article), the advice to test two clearly different variants, and the Tubefilter rollout history (July 2025, stale but accurate). Weak: the vendor impression thresholds, the Reddit anecdote, the Shorts idea list, and the gaming-thumbnail style blogs. These are opinion with no performance data, and several were not opened, so they stay hypotheses. Refuted: the closed-mouth / restraint thumbnail claim and the shock-faces-fading claim. The cited rizzle page is from August 2024 and says nothing of the sort. Overall packaging evidence is thin, with no hard data on title or thumbnail styles for gaming essays in the last 60 days. The 2-variant test plan is reasonable but rests on process, not on proven style trends. Spend: I cannot measure cost, only about 14.94M tokens left of 15M, and the user should check the billing page."
